integrity: Symbolic derivations are documented and separately checked by exact enumeration for bounded sizes. The formulas are proved analytically for all integer n>=3 and real theta>0; finite checks alone would not establish that scope.
scientific_limitations: Exact first mixed moments and covariance signs, not joint laws or independence. The leading near-uniform scaling law is inconclusive at its zero boundary. The Ewens inversion mean and pair probabilities are published antecedents; a more implicit historical enumeration may cover the algebraic consequences. Independent mathematical evaluation has not been performed.
title: The fixed-point–inversion sign geometry of Ewens permutations
